chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim, from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his grandfather, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

Be more hopeful for what you do not expect than for what you expect. For indeed, Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام went out to bring fire for his family, then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, spoke to him, and he returned as a Prophet. And the Queen of Sabaʾ went out and submitted with Sulaymān عليه السلام. And the magicians of Firʿawn went out seeking might for Firʿawn, but they returned as believers.

key_terms.سَحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ: the magicians of Pharaoh who embraced faith
key_terms.لِمَا لَا تَرْجُو: that which one does not expect or hope for
key_terms.مَلِكَةُ سَبَإٍ: the Queen of Sheba, cited as an example of guidance
key_terms.مُؤْمِنِينَ: believers, those who returned with iman (faith)
key_terms.يَقْتَبِسُ: seeking to take or bring back a flame of fire

ai.seo_question: How does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام teach believers to hope for unexpected good from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a profound ethic of hope in Allah’s unseen openings, reminding the believer that outcomes may come from places they did not anticipate. Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام illustrates this through examples from sacred history, where people set out for one purpose but returned transformed by divine guidance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5854 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Abdullah ibn Al-Qasim, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his grandfather Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as), from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), who said:

"Be more hopeful for what you do not expect than for what you expect.
For indeed, Musa ibn Imran (as), peace be upon him, went out to bring fire for his family and returned as a prophet after Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, spoke to him.
The Queen of Sheba went out and embraced Islam with Prophet Sulayman, peace be upon him.
And the magicians of Pharaoh went out seeking honor for Pharaoh but returned as believers."
